working: The 2026-09-15 'Alumni eNews - September 2026' was the first genuinely fresh (non-resend) campaign since 09-08 and pulled a 43.89% open rate — well above the 25-35% health/nonprofit benchmark — after two straight cycles of resend/recovery-only sends.
Direct + Organic Search still anchor the site: 51.1% and 33.3% of the 32,930 sessions in the trailing window, both flat vs. the 2026-09-14 run — a stable base, no erosion.

All three data sources are live and clean this cycle: GA4 (1,060 days x 15 channels), Constant Contact (100 campaigns synced, most recent send 2026-09-15), and GSC — no auth failures, a contrast to the CC outages earlier this year (08-10).

The 09-11 Referring Partners 'Bounce Recovery' resend and the paired 09-08 sends ('This is BCC' Staff-Client + Referring Partners August) both landed during a real traffic spike: +55.1% and +79.7% lift respectively — Monday/Wednesday original sends are clearly outperforming the Sunday resend slot (see not_working).
not_working: The 09-15 Alumni send's own session lift was -1.2% despite the strong 43.89% open rate, and its click rate was only 0.67% — opens aren't converting to site visits or clicks, suggesting a CTA/content mismatch rather than a deliverability problem.

UTM leakage persists on the 09-15 send: direct_sessions_3d (20) outpaces email_sessions_3d (5) by 4x — the same historical pattern, meaning GA4 is very likely crediting most of that traffic to Direct instead of Email and understating newsletter impact.

GSC clicks have declined three cycles running — 12 (09-09 run) -> 10 (09-14) -> 8 (09-16) — on a 1,550-impression, 7-day window (avg. position 18.56). The 7-day window makes any single reading noisy, but three consecutive drops is worth tracking as a real trend.

The 09-13 'Staff-Client eNews Aug 2026 (Non-opener resend, Sunday)' again logged a negative lift (-9.4%), continuing the pattern where Sunday non-opener resends underperform their own pre-send baseline.
Organic Social remains marginal at 5.2% of sessions, essentially flat for a fifth straight report.
do_next: Add utm_source=constantcontact&utm_medium=email (plus a per-send utm_campaign) to Constant Contact templates — still the single highest-leverage unfixed item; the 4x Direct-over-Email gap on 09-15 shows it's still not done.

Test a stronger CTA or above-the-fold link placement on the Alumni eNews format — the 09-15 send proved the list opens (43.89%) but isn't clicking (0.67%), so the fix is in the email body, not the subject line or send time.

Favor Monday/Wednesday original sends over Sunday resends going forward — the two 09-08 original sends both landed 79.7% lift vs. the 09-13 Sunday non-opener resend's -9.4%; consider retiring the Sunday non-opener slot or testing a weekday resend instead.

Watch the GSC click count (12 -> 10 -> 8) for a fourth consecutive drop next run; if it continues, treat it as a real ranking/CTR issue rather than window noise and escalate to a GSC query-level check.
Repromote the 'This is BCC' staff-client content angle — it paired with the best-performing send window this cycle (79.7% lift) and is a natural theme to reuse for the next original campaign.
summary: Traffic held flat at 32,930 sessions with Direct/Organic unchanged, and the first fresh (non-resend) newsletter in over a week — the 09-15 Alumni eNews — pulled a strong 43.89% open rate but converted almost none of it into site lift or clicks, while UTM leakage and a three-cycle GSC click decline remain the open issues to fix.
